titulo_ja: しよう と ところ (2)

bloques.titulo: In this context, the Commission will be able to make a contribution to the implementation of the programme.
texto: To say that something is going to start right now: verb in the form of a dictionary + **ところ です**: **いま、 ちょうど でかける ところ です** (I'm about to leave right now).
It goes with **ちょうど** (just) when the moment is right.

bloques.titulo: In doing so, it turned out that
texto: To tell what happened when something was done: verb in the form) + **ところ**: **でんわ を かけた ところ、 でませんでした** (I called, but did not answer). The result may be surprising, although the surprise is not mandatory.

frases.en: I'm gonna call a friend right now. He's not home, though. After he left a message, he called me back right away.

intro: Now two expressions to talk about moments: when something is about to happen and when something just happened and the result was not the expected one.
